invariants.rationale: A non-null Map is always returned (either empty or populated).
Method argument is required for processing; null would indicate a programming error.
The returned object has type Map<String, List<String>>.
Lists in the map are either absent (empty map) or guaranteed non-null by the code constructing the map.
Partition paths (keys) are non-null as they derive from getAllPartitionPaths output which doesn't return null elements.
